svg.text: CAECILIA GABRIEL | BELIEVE IT | AGE 7 | LATE MARCH 1922
CHARACTER CONCEPT v02 · PLATE 3/3 · COSTUME CONSTRUCTION AND MATERIALS
— brown leather lace-up ankle boots (Schnürstiefel), 12 cm high, 20.5 cm long, 5 eyelet pairs, toe cap, back strap with pull loop; leather sole and stacked heel
iron heel plate — standard for country
looking lug sole of the v01 detail.
greyed at the lap, boot toes
— swatches are the v01 texture maps, unmodified
2 Buttoned under-bodice (Leibchen) with elastic straps that hold
the stockings — hidden; explains why the stockings do not slip.
3 Hand-knit wool stockings, over the knee, grey-olive.
4 Wool dress: front-buttoned bodice with pintucks, waist seam,
gathered skirt ending mid-calf, 3 cm let-down hem.
5 Linen half apron tied in a bow at centre back, tails ≈ 15 cm.
6 Ankle boots. No jewellery, no hat, no modern fastenings
(no zips, snaps or elastic visible anywhere).
Develops caecilia_gabriel/v01 (concept-preview.webp + GLB). All views generated from one measurement set — see design-notes.md
